tagline: Minox取景器相机，1985 年发布
description: Minox于1985年推出的取景器相机。配备35 mm f/2.8 (four elements in three groups)。快门速度1/500 to more than 2 seconds。使用35mm film。感光度ISO 25 (15°) to ISO 1600 (33°)。0.9m to infinity。

specs.镜头: 35 mm f/2.8 (four elements in three groups)
specs.英文简介: The Minox name carries James Bond cachet and the Minox 35 line has the honor of being the smallest and lighter production full-frame 35mm camera made.
